notes: Covers Lasko model 754200 as described in its Rev. B 3/10 manual: a 120 V ceramic heater with a thermostat knob and a power knob (Off, Fan Only, Low Heat, High Heat). Parts Town's page for this model lists two knobs, 7542001 (switch knob) and 7542002 (thermostat knob).

gaps: The manual says only 'ceramic heater'; no element type is given, so PTC is not claimed.
1500 W is stated for the High Heat setting of the whole heater, not for the element itself; the manual gives no Low Heat wattage and retailer snippets disagreed (900 W and 750 W), so none is claimed.
The 120 V figure is stated for the wall outlet and plug, not for any part, so v is not set; ac is set only on the cord.
The thermal overload protector has no stated type, rating or count, so qty and ratings are left out.
The manual never names a tip-over switch, so none is claimed.
Fan motor type and rating and cord wire gauge are not stated, so the fan carries no ac flag.
The manual says there are no user-serviceable parts.
method: Lasko operating manual for model 754200, Rev. B 3/10, bilingual English and Spanish, 4 pages, PDF on Home Depot's image server. Read in full; the operation, thermostat and safety-feature text is on PDF pages 2 and 3, and the maker's name, model and Rev. code are in the text.
Parts Town page for model 754200: lists two knobs (7542001, 7542002) and no other parts.
Not read by the researcher: the Lasko product page (HTTP 429), the Appliance Factory Parts page (HTTP 403) and the Farnell copy of the manual (Rev. C 5/13).

comps.spec: Heating element of a heater the manual calls a ceramic heater. The 1500 W is the whole heater's High Heat setting, not a separate element rating.
Fan that runs alone on the Fan Only (no heat) setting of the power knob.
Adjustable thermostat knob. The heater cycles on and off to hold the set temperature.
Built-in thermal overload protector that shuts the heater off if it overheats.
Power knob with Off (0), Fan Only, Low Heat (1) and High Heat (2) positions.
Cord set with a polarized plug (one blade wider than the other).
